intro: About 120 kcal for 1 tepung pelita. Most of the calories come from the white santan layer on top.
diet: Yes, tepung pelita is small and light for a santan kuih. It's soft, so it's easy to finish two or three. One piece as dessert after buka puasa or dinner is totally okay. Just remember, santan still adds fat.
tips: Buy just 1-2 pieces, not a whole box.
Eat it after a main meal with protein, not as a meal replacement.
If making your own, use half santan and half low-fat milk.

swap.name: Agar-agar santan 1 piece
swap.why: Lighter and still has that santan pandan taste.

faq.q: Why is it called tepung pelita?
faq.a: The folded banana leaf cup looks like a pelita, the traditional oil lamp.
It's always at the Ramadan bazaar, but you can find it at kuih stalls all year round.

faq.q: Why didn't my tepung pelita santan layer set?
faq.a: Usually the heat is too high or you didn't stir continuously. Cook the santan on low heat until thick.
